title: Money Lab
tagline: Learn to run your own money: budgets, saving, banks, credit cards, and getting out of debt.
howTo: Pick a section below. Start with Money Basics if you are new. They build on each other from top to bottom.
Open Learn and swipe through the short lesson cards. Each one takes about a minute.
Open Try it to play with a real calculator. Change the numbers and watch what happens.
Ready for real money? Open the Budget Sheet (in Tools). Fill in one sheet each month: plan it, track what you really spend, and print or download it.
Do the Practice questions. You can try again as many times as you want, and every answer explains why.
Take the Quiz when you feel ready. Your best score is saved.
Use Cards (flashcards) and the Glossary at the bottom of the screen to review words you forget.
notice: Money Lab is for learning. Numbers like tax rates, fees, and interest rates are realistic examples, not advice for your exact situation. Everything you enter stays on this device.
